h.en: 3.1.1 Plastic deformation and hot versus cold working

body.en:
Forming changes shape by plastic deformation rather than removing chips or filling a molten-metal mould. Adequate ductility and controlled stress/temperature are required; elastic springback remains after unloading.

Hot working occurs above the relevant recrystallisation range and reduces work hardening, permitting large strain but often oxidation, scale and less precise finish. Cold working below that range improves finish/accuracy and can strengthen by strain hardening, but increases forces, residual stress and risk of cracking. Hot/cold is relative to the material,not a universal100°C boundary.
body.gu:
Forming plastic deformation થી shape બદલે,chips removal/melting mould નહિ. Ductility/stress/temperature control જરૂરી;unload પછી springback રહે.

Hot relevant recrystallisation range ઉપર:large strain/low work-hardening પણ scale/finish limits. Cold નીચે:accuracy/finish/strain hardening strength પણ higher force,residual stress,crack risk. Universal100°C boundary નથી.

body.en:
Compressive tools deform stock without fully enclosing its lateral outline. Repositioning produces the required section.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A hammer/press supplies controlled compressive strokes or load.
  2. A rigid frame and foundation carry reaction forces.
  3. Upper and lower flat/simple dies contact the work without a fully closed impression.
  4. Tongs/manipulators hold suitable stock clear of pinch zones.
  5. Approved heating equipment conditions hot-work stock when required.
  6. Measuring templates/gauges track length,section and allowance.
  7. Guards,scale screens and rated handling support safe operation.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select forgeable material and initial stock/allowance.
  2. Condition to the approved hot/cold work state and verify tooling.
  3. Locate stock using rated handling and correct die support.
  4. Apply controlled compression to reduce height or section.
  5. Reposition/rotate through the planned sequence to draw out or upset geometry.
  6. Complete finishing stages with required allowances and controlled cooling.
  7. Inspect dimensions,folds/cracks and specified integrity before further machining.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Large shafts,rings and low-quantity parts;flexible tooling and favourable worked structure are merits. Skill,handling,accuracy and machining stock are limits;not every internal defect is healed by forging.
body.gu:
Compressive tools stock ને lateral full enclosure વગર deform કરે;repositioning થી section બને.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Hammer/press controlled stroke/load આપે.
  2. Rigid frame/foundation reaction વહન કરે.
  3. Flat/simple dies full enclosure વગર work touch કરે.
  4. Tongs/manipulators pinch zoneથી દૂર stock hold કરે.
  5. Hot working માટે approved heating જરૂરી.
  6. Gauges/templates length,section,allowance બતાવે.
  7. Guards/scale screens/rated handling safety માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Forgeable material/stock/allowance પસંદ કરો.
  2. Approved hot/cold state/tooling verify.
  3. Rated handlingથી stock locate/support.
  4. Controlled compression height/section ઘટાડે.
  5. Planned reposition/rotateથી draw-out/upset shape.
  6. Allowances/controlled cooling સાથે finish.
  7. Dimensions,folds/cracks,integrity inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Large shafts/rings/low quantity;flexibility/worked structure લાભ. Skill,handling,accuracy,machining stock limits;દરેક internal defect heal નથી થતો.

body.en:
Shaped die impressions direct flow toward the component outline. Conventional impression-die forging often produces flash;precision flashless forging is a stricter volume-controlled case.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A drop hammer or forging press supplies rated energy/load.
  2. Matched die blocks contain preform/finishing impressions.
  3. Die holders and guides maintain alignment under load.
  4. A flash land/gutter controls excess flow in flash-producing tooling.
  5. Billet heating and approved lubrication manage flow/friction.
  6. Manipulators and ejecting/handling features move hot parts safely.
  7. Trimming and inspection tooling removes flash and checks the forging.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Calculate stock volume including stated scale,flash,tong and punching losses.
  2. Prepare dies/stock and the approved heating condition.
  3. Use preforming stages to distribute material before final filling.
  4. Load the finishing impression with controlled location/alignment.
  5. Compress so metal flows into detail;excess forms designed flash where applicable.
  6. Remove/trim by the approved stage and cool/heat-treat as specified.
  7. Inspect fill,alignment,cracks and dimensional allowances.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Connecting rods,spanners and repeat-production shapes. Repeatability/productivity are merits;die cost,volume control,flash loss and high loads are limits. Press forging applies slower sustained load;drop forging uses impacts.
body.gu:
Shaped dies flow component તરફ direct કરે;conventional type માં flash;flashless precise volume-control case છે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Drop hammer/press rated energy/load આપે.
  2. Matched dies preform/finish impressions રાખે.
  3. Holders/guides load હેઠળ alignment રાખે.
  4. Flash land/gutter excess flow control કરે.
  5. Heating/approved lubrication flow/friction manage કરે.
  6. Manipulator/ejection hot parts safely move કરે.
  7. Trimming/inspection flash remove/check કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Scale,flash,tong,punch losses સાથે stock ગણો.
  2. Dies/stock/heating prepare.
  3. Preformથી final fill પહેલાં metal distribute.
  4. Finish impressionમાં controlled location.
  5. Compression detail ભરે;excess designed flash બને.
  6. Approved removal/trim,cool/heat-treat.
  7. Fill,alignment,cracks,allowances inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Connecting rods/spanners/repeat parts. Repeatability લાભ;die cost,volume,flash,load limits. Press sustained/slower load;drop impacts આપે.

body.en:
Smith/open-die uses simple tools;impression/drop/press describes tooling or loading;upset forging increases section by axial compression,commonly bolt heads;roll forging uses grooved rolls for preforms;precision/flashless needs tightly controlled billet volume. These classifications overlap.

Underfill can follow low volume,poor flow or unsuitable temperature;laps/folds follow metal folding;die mismatch follows alignment errors;cracks reflect excessive strain/poor thermal control;scale pits arise from entrapped oxide. Control stock,preform,die condition,temperature/lubrication and alignment. “Cold shut” in forging is a folded/unwelded flow defect,not a liquid stream collision.
body.gu:
Smith/open-die simple tools;impression/drop/press tooling/loading;upset axial compression થી bolt-head જેવી section;roll forging grooved preforms;flashless exact volume. Classifications overlap.

Underfill low volume/flow;lap folded metal;mismatch alignment;cracks strain/thermal;scale pits oxide. Stock,preform,die,temp,lubrication,alignment control. Forging cold-shut liquid streams નથી,folded/unjoined flow છે.

h.en: 3.3.1 Rolling: reduction through a roll bite

body.en:
Opposed rotating rolls compress stock;friction draws it into the bite and length increases as section decreases.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Work rolls provide the contacting cylindrical/grooved surfaces.
  2. Bearings/chocks locate rolls and carry separating loads.
  3. A mill stand/frame resists deflection under force.
  4. Drive gearing/motors rotate rolls in the required opposed directions.
  5. Gap/screw-down controls set nominal reduction.
  6. Entry/exit tables and guides control stock travel and alignment.
  7. Cooling/lubrication,guards and measurement systems support the selected hot/cold process.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Choose stock/material and hot/cold rolling route with planned passes.
  2. Prepare rolls and nominal gaps under authorised isolated setup.
  3. Guide stock into the entry while keeping personnel outside nip hazards.
  4. Roll friction pulls stock into the bite as normal compression reduces thickness.
  5. Control passes,temperature and tension where applicable to achieve reduction.
  6. Size/straighten/cool or coil by the specified downstream sequence.
  7. Inspect thickness,flatness,surface and edge/centre defects.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Sheet,plate,rails and sections. High throughput is a merit;mill investment,load,shape control and defects are limits. Two-high,reversing,three-high,four-high,cluster,tandem and universal mills serve different reduction/support needs.
body.gu:
Rotating rolls compress કરે;friction bite માં ખેંચે અને section ઘટતાં length વધે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Work rolls contact surfaces આપે.
  2. Bearings/chocks separating loads વહન કરે.
  3. Mill frame force/deflection resist કરે.
  4. Drive rolls required opposed directionsમાં ફેરવે.
  5. Gap/screw-down nominal reduction set કરે.
  6. Entry/exit tables/guides alignment રાખે.
  7. Cooling/lube,guards,measurement selected process support કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Stock/material/route/passes પસંદ કરો.
  2. Authorised isolated setupમાં rolls/gap તૈયાર.
  3. Stock guide;personnel nipથી દૂર.
  4. Friction stock ખેંચે;normal force thickness ઘટાડે.
  5. Passes,temp,applicable tension control.
  6. Specified sizing/straighten/cool/coil.
  7. Thickness,flatness,surface/edge/centre inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Sheet/plate/rails/sections. Throughput લાભ;investment,load,shape/defects limits. Two-high,reversing,three-high,four-high,cluster,tandem,universal અલગ needs માટે.

body.en:
Two-high has two work rolls;reversing changes drive direction between passes. Three-high permits alternating pass levels. Four-high uses small work rolls supported by large backup rolls;cluster extends support. Tandem stands give successive reductions;universal mills include vertical rolls for width/section control.

Wavy edges and centre buckle reflect nonuniform elongation/flatness;edge cracks relate to ductility/stress;alligatoring splits through thickness;surface marks can follow damaged rolls/scale. Correct roll profile,alignment,reduction,temperature and material condition according to diagnosis;do not remove guards to watch the bite.
body.gu:
Two-high બે work rolls;reversing direction બદલે;three-high alternate levels;four-high small work+large backup;cluster વધુ support;tandem successive stands;universal vertical rolls.

Wavy edges/centre buckle uneven elongation;edge cracks ductility/stress;alligatoring thickness split;marks roll/scale. Diagnosis પ્રમાણે roll profile,alignment,reduction,temp,material સુધારો;guard દૂર ન કરો.

body.en:
Tensile pulling forces stock through a converging die,reducing its cross-section without chip removal.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A hardened die provides approach,reduction,bearing and exit regions.
  2. A die holder aligns the tool and carries reaction load.
  3. A capstan or drawbench supplies continuous or straight pulling.
  4. A pointed stock end and approved grip permit starting without hand contact in the die.
  5. Lubrication/cleaning equipment controls friction and surface quality.
  6. Payoff/takeup or handling guides maintain controlled stock path.
  7. Guards,break containment and gauges address whipping and size control.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select drawable stock and the specified reduction/pass schedule.
  2. Clean,condition and lubricate by the approved route.
  3. Prepare/thread the starting end only under safe setup conditions.
  4. Engage the rated grip and pulling drive with guarding active.
  5. Pull through the die so section decreases and length increases.
  6. Repeat approved passes with intermediate treatment if work hardening requires it.
  7. Inspect size,surface and breaks;coil/cut as specified.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Wire,electrical conductor and accurate bars. Finish/tolerance improve but strain hardening,draw force,die wear and central/surface cracking limit reductions. Drawing is not sheet deep drawing,which uses a punch and blank.
body.gu:
Tensile pulling converging dieમાંથી stock ખેંચી section ઘટાડે,chips વગર.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Hardened die approach/reduction/bearing/exit આપે.
  2. Die holder alignment/reaction load લે.
  3. Capstan/drawbench pulling આપે.
  4. Pointed end/approved grip safe starting માટે.
  5. Lube/cleaning friction/surface control.
  6. Payoff/takeup/guides path જાળવે.
  7. Guards/break containment/gauges whipping/size માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Drawable stock/reduction/passes પસંદ કરો.
  2. Approved clean/condition/lubricate.
  3. Safe setupમાં starting end prepare/thread.
  4. Rated grip/drive;guard active.
  5. Dieથી pull;section ઘટે,length વધે.
  6. Required hardening treatment સાથે approved repeat passes.
  7. Size,surface,breaks inspect;coil/cut.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Wire/conductor/accurate bars. Finish/tolerance લાભ;hardening,force,die wear/cracks limits. આ sheet deep drawing નથી.

h.en: 3.3.4 Tube drawing: plug/mandrel and sinking variants

body.en:
A tube is pulled through a die;an internal plug/mandrel may control bore and wall. Tube sinking omits the internal tool.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. An external drawing die sets the outside reduction geometry.
  2. A fixed/floating plug or mandrel supports/controls the bore where specified.
  3. A drawbench/capstan supplies tensile pulling through a rated grip.
  4. Alignment supports prevent tube/tool eccentricity.
  5. Inside/outside lubrication reduces friction at active contacts.
  6. Tube preparation and intermediate heat-treatment provisions suit the alloy.
  7. Guards,handling and wall/bore gauges complete the setup.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select sound tube stock and the intended sinking/plug/mandrel method.
  2. Prepare,clean and lubricate the tube by the specified route.
  3. Align internal tooling where used and prepare the gripped leading end.
  4. Pull through the outer die while internal contact controls the bore in supported methods.
  5. Continue controlled travel without exceeding approved reduction/strain limits.
  6. Use further passes/treatment only as the scheduled process requires.
  7. Inspect outside diameter,wall,bore,straightness and surface.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Precision tubes for mechanical/heat-exchanger duties. Good dimensions/finish are merits;tool access,friction,hardening and eccentricity are limits. Sinking does not control wall as directly as an internal-tool method.
body.gu:
Tube dieથી pull થાય;plug/mandrel bore/wall control;સિંકિંગમાં internal tool નહિ.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. External die outside reduction આપે.
  2. Specified plug/mandrel bore control આપે.
  3. Bench/capstan rated gripથી pull આપે.
  4. Supports eccentricity ઘટાડે.
  5. Inside/outside lubrication friction ઘટાડે.
  6. Preparation/intermediate treatment alloy મુજબ.
  7. Guards/handling/wall-bore gauges setup પૂર્ણ કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Sound stock અને method પસંદ કરો.
  2. Tube prepare/clean/lube.
  3. Used internal tool align;leading end grip prepare.
  4. Outer dieથી pull;internal contact bore control કરે.
  5. Approved reduction/strain limits હેઠળ travel.
  6. Scheduled further passes/treatment જ.
  7. OD,wall,bore,straightness,surface inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Precision mechanical/heat-exchanger tubes. Dimensions/finish લાભ;access,friction,hardening,eccentricity limits. Sinking wall control internal-tool જેટલું direct નથી.

body.en:
A punch draws a sheet blank into a die cavity;the flange feeds inward to form a cup. This differs from wire drawing through a reducing die.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A press supplies the guided punch stroke and reaction force.
  2. A punch defines the internal cup surface and bottom geometry.
  3. A die with suitable entry radius supports sheet as it changes direction.
  4. A blank holder restrains the flange without preventing all inward flow.
  5. A measured sheet blank supplies the required area and material direction.
  6. Approved lubrication reduces friction at punch,die and flange contacts.
  7. Guards,feeding/ejection and inspection features control press hazards and product quality.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Choose drawable sheet,blank size and the approved draw sequence.
  2. Prepare/lubricate and locate the blank on the die under safe setup conditions.
  3. Apply the designed blank-holder restraint before the draw stroke.
  4. The punch advances and bends sheet over the die entry into the cavity.
  5. Flange material flows inward while the wall and base develop under controlled stress.
  6. Complete the stroke and use designed stripping/ejection;redraw only by the planned route.
  7. Inspect thinning,tears,wrinkles,earing and cup dimensions before trimming.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Cups,cans and sheet housings. Efficient hollow sheet shapes are a merit;formability,wrinkling,tearing,earing and draw limits constrain geometry. Earing can reflect sheet anisotropy;blank-holder force is not simply maximised.
body.gu:
Punch sheet blankને dieમાં draw કરે;flange inward flowથી cup બને. Wire drawingથી અલગ.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Press guided punch stroke/reaction આપે.
  2. Punch inside cup/bottom define કરે.
  3. Entry-radius die direction change support કરે.
  4. Blank holder flange restrain,પણ inward flow allow કરે.
  5. Sized sheet blank required area/direction આપે.
  6. Approved lube punch/die/flange friction ઘટાડે.
  7. Guards/feed/ejection/inspection press hazards/quality માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Drawable sheet,size,draw sequence પસંદ કરો.
  2. Safe setupમાં blank prepare/lube/locate.
  3. Stroke પહેલાં designed holder restraint.
  4. Punch sheetને die entryથી cavityમાં bend કરે.
  5. Flange inward flowથી wall/base બને.
  6. Designed strip/eject;planned redraw જ.
  7. Thinning,tear,wrinkle,earing,size inspect,પછી trim.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Cups,cans,housings. Efficient hollow shapes લાભ;formability,wrinkles,tears,earing,draw limits. Earing anisotropyથી;holder force maximum કરવો solution નહિ.

body.en:
A ram pushes a confined billet through a die;metal exits in the ram travel direction.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A strong container confines the billet laterally.
  2. A stationary die at the exit defines the extruded section.
  3. A ram/stem and dummy block transmit compressive force.
  4. A rated press/frame withstands axial load and reaction.
  5. Heating/control and lubrication suit hot or cold operation.
  6. Guides,runout and cut-off equipment support the product.
  7. Guards,interlocks and billet handling keep personnel clear.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Choose billet volume,alloy and process condition.
  2. Prepare the compatible die/container under approved setup.
  3. Load the billet by rated handling and close the press arrangement.
  4. Ram compression raises stress and initiates flow through the die.
  5. Continue controlled travel;billet slides against the container,adding friction.
  6. End the stroke before the specified discard/butt region and handle it separately.
  7. Cool,straighten/cut and inspect profile/surface as required.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Continuous bars,channels and profiles;versatile sections but container friction,high force,butt loss and die wear are limits. Hollow profiles require designed mandrels/bridge tooling.
body.gu:
Ram confined billet dieથી push કરે;exit ram directionમાં.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Strong container billet laterally confine કરે.
  2. Stationary die section define કરે.
  3. Ram/stem/dummy block force આપે.
  4. Rated press/frame axial load લે.
  5. Heating/control/lube hot/cold મુજબ.
  6. Guides/runout/cut-off product support.
  7. Guards/interlocks/handling personnel clear રાખે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Billet volume/alloy/condition પસંદ કરો.
  2. Approved compatible die/container prepare.
  3. Rated handlingથી load/close.
  4. Ram stress flow initiate કરે.
  5. Travelમાં billet-container sliding friction વધે.
  6. Specified butt/discard પહેલાં end;separate handling.
  7. Cool/straighten/cut/profile inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Bars/channels/profiles;versatile,પણ container friction,force,butt loss,die wear limits. Hollow માટે designed mandrels/bridge tooling.

body.en:
A die on a hollow ram moves into the billet;metal flows back through the ram. Reduced billet/container sliding lowers friction.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A container holds the billet against a closed backing end.
  2. A hollow ram carries the die at its leading end.
  3. The ram bore provides the product exit path.
  4. A rated press and guided supports align the moving die.
  5. Thermal/lubrication provisions match alloy and process.
  6. Product clearance/handling accommodates flow toward the ram side.
  7. Guards and discard-removal tools control high-load hazards.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Prepare billet,container and die for the specified route.
  2. Confine the billet against its designed rear support.
  3. Align the hollow ram and die before the guarded stroke.
  4. Advance the die into the billet to create compressive flow.
  5. Metal passes through the die back into the hollow ram rather than sliding fully along the container.
  6. Stop/withdraw and remove product/discard by the approved sequence.
  7. Inspect dimensions and surface;check ram/die condition after isolation.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Lower friction/force than comparable direct extrusion,with suitable surface benefits. Hollow-ram strength,product size/length and handling constrain equipment. Do not confuse ram motion with metal exit direction.
body.gu:
Hollow ram પર die billetમાં જાય;metal ramથી પાછળ આવે. Billet/container sliding ઓછું.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Container closed backing સામે billet રાખે.
  2. Hollow ram front પર die રાખે.
  3. Ram bore product exit આપે.
  4. Rated press/guides moving die align કરે.
  5. Thermal/lube alloy/process મુજબ.
  6. Handling/clearance ram-side flow માટે.
  7. Guards/discard tools high-load hazards માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Billet/container/die prepare.
  2. Billet rear support સામે confine.
  3. Guarded stroke પહેલાં hollow ram/die align.
  4. Die advanceથી compressive flow.
  5. Metal dieથી hollow ramમાં પાછું;full container sliding નહિ.
  6. Approved stop/withdraw/product/discard removal.
  7. Dimensions/surface inspect;isolation પછી ram/die.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Comparable direct કરતાં lower friction/force. Hollow-ram strength,size/length,handling limits. Ram motion અને product direction અલગ.

body.en:
A pressurised fluid transmits compressive pressure around the billet and drives it through a die,reducing direct billet-container friction.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A pressure-rated chamber confines billet and medium.
  2. A compatible pressure fluid surrounds the billet.
  3. A plunger/intensifier pressurises the fluid rather than directly pushing the full billet surface.
  4. A sealed die/exit arrangement contains pressure and shapes the product.
  5. Seals and supporting tools are selected for pressure,temperature and fluid compatibility.
  6. Instrumentation monitors pressure and system integrity.
  7. Containment,interlocks and approved depressurisation provisions protect the installation.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select compatible billet,fluid and temperature range.
  2. Prepare seals/tooling and load through the authorised safe system.
  3. Fill/seal the designed fluid space without trapped unsafe conditions.
  4. Controlled plunger action raises hydrostatic pressure around the billet.
  5. Billet flows through the die as pressure exceeds forming resistance.
  6. Complete the approved stroke and controlled pressure release before access.
  7. Handle/inspect product and check fluid/seal condition by procedure.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Reduced friction and compressive stress state can aid difficult materials. High-pressure sealing,fluid limits and specialised equipment restrict use;never improvise pressure vessels.
body.gu:
Pressurised fluid billet આસપાસ pressure આપી dieથી flow કરાવે;direct container friction ઓછું.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Pressure-rated chamber billet/medium રાખે.
  2. Compatible fluid billet આસપાસ.
  3. Plunger/intensifier fluid pressure આપે.
  4. Sealed die/exit pressure contain/shape કરે.
  5. Seals/tools pressure,temp,fluid માટે rated.
  6. Instruments pressure/integrity monitor કરે.
  7. Containment/interlocks/approved depressurisation જરૂરી.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Compatible billet/fluid/temp પસંદ કરો.
  2. Authorised safe seals/tooling/load.
  3. Designed fluid space safe રીતે fill/seal.
  4. Controlled plunger hydrostatic pressure વધારે.
  5. Pressure resistance ઉપર જાય ત્યારે die flow.
  6. Approved stroke/pressure release પછી જ access.
  7. Product inspect;fluid/seal check.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Reduced friction/compressive state difficult materialsમાં મદદરૂપ. High-pressure seals/fluid/special equipment limits;pressure vessel improvise નહિ.

body.en:
A punch rapidly compresses a measured slug;in backward impact extrusion material flows around the punch to form a hollow cup.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A rigid press supplies the required rapid stroke/energy.
  2. A die supports the slug and outside cup form.
  3. A guided punch defines the cup interior and transmits load.
  4. A precisely sized ductile slug controls product volume.
  5. Approved lubrication reduces severe tool-contact friction.
  6. Ejector/stripper removes the cup without unsafe manual pulling.
  7. Guards,feed controls and inspection tools manage repetitive press hazards.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select suitable ductile material and measured slug.
  2. Prepare/lubricate slug and dies by procedure.
  3. Locate slug while the press is in its safe loading condition.
  4. The guarded punch stroke compresses the slug.
  5. Metal flows backward around the punch,forming wall and base.
  6. Retract and strip/eject by the designed mechanism.
  7. Inspect wall/base thickness,cracks and dimensions.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Tubes,containers and suitable thin-wall parts,often in ductile non-ferrous metals. High output/low scrap are merits;material ductility,tool loads and shape limits matter. Forward/combined impact variants have different flow paths.
body.gu:
Punch measured slugને ઝડપથી compress કરે;backward typeમાં metal punch આસપાસ ઉપર cup બને.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Rigid press rapid stroke/energy આપે.
  2. Die slug/outside cup support.
  3. Guided punch inside shape/load આપે.
  4. Sized ductile slug volume control.
  5. Approved lubrication friction ઘટાડે.
  6. Ejector/stripper safe removal આપે.
  7. Guards/feed controls/inspection repetitive hazards માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Suitable ductile material/slug પસંદ કરો.
  2. Procedure મુજબ slug/die prepare/lube.
  3. Safe loading conditionમાં slug locate.
  4. Guarded punch slug compress કરે.
  5. Metal punch આસપાસ backward wall/base બનાવે.
  6. Designed retract/strip/eject.
  7. Wall/base thickness,cracks,dimensions inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Ductile non-ferrous tubes/containers/thin walls. Output/low scrap લાભ;ductility,tool load,shape limits. Forward/combined paths અલગ.

body.en:
Crush/nip points,hot scale,heavy tooling,stored pressure,ejected stock and sharp products require guarding,rated lifting,interlocks and lockout before maintenance. Never reach between dies or into roll bites. Temperature colour alone is not a safe handling test.

Drawing/extrusion defects include surface cracking,central burst,die lines and dimensional error;causes include excessive reduction,friction,tool geometry,contamination and thermal condition. Diagnose before changing settings. Sound surface appearance does not guarantee freedom from internal cracks.
body.gu:

Drawing/extrusion surface cracks,central burst,die lines,size errors:reduction,friction,geometry,contamination,temp તપાસો. Surface sound એટલે internal crack-free નહિ.
